statement: Rest categories use strict lower bounds .28/.14/.01; awake loss multipliers are Rested1,Tired.7,VeryTired.3,Exhausted.6.
Rest interval adds .005714286*effectiveness*RestRateMultiplier while resting; otherwise subtracts BaseRestFallPerTick*category*health*150*RestFallRateFactor. Resting does not also incur awake loss.
Colonist timetable defaults Sleep22..05 and Anything06..21. Work disallows rest/joy; other selected assignments retain class defaults allowing rest.
After prerequisite checks, Anything/Joy gives rest job priority8 below.3, Work0, Sleep8. Selection creates bed or validated ground sleep job.

Ordinary voluntary sleep requires rest<.75, no blocking health condition, no disturbance within400ticks and interruptible current job. Natural wake is normally rest>=1; life stages/lords can override. Adult life-stage class default permits sleep while starving.

For non-downed ordinary nonforced sleep, disturbance or Work with rest>=.2 releases keep-lying-down; urgent food category and rest>.14 releases it only if suitable food can be found. Becoming Anything at06 does not itself wake a sleeper.

LayDown samples comfort separately and only signals rest while asleep and gainRest. Ground or a bed without explicit BedRestEffectiveness uses valueIfMissing.8. Other jobs are checked on hash interval211.

Comfort targets recent object comfort clamped0..1, else0; seeker rises.60/hour and falls.04/hour. Comfort has no freezeWhileSleeping override; GUI arrow0 while asleep does not mean its need is frozen.
Selected bed parent chain declares PassThroughOnly, pathCost42, base comfort.75; Bed declares size(1,2), rest effectiveness1,45stuff and800base work. Bedroll declares effectiveness.95 and comfort.68.

Quality multipliers for rest are .86/.92/1/1.08/1.14/1.25/1.6; comfort .76/.88/1/1.12/1.24/1.45/1.7. StatPart_Quality adds multiplied gain limited by MaxGain; selected stat declarations have no finite MaxGain overrides.
Sleeping slot count is unrotated size.x; a1x2 bed has one slot. Head/feet cell mapping depends on rotated occupied rectangle.
Ownership is persistent assignment, not current occupancy. Nonmedical claim unclaims previous bed and updates both assignment and pawn.OwnedBed; explicit claim can displace last owner of a full bed.

Automatic bed selection validates same map, fire, body/species suitability, social ownership, occupancy, forbidden state, reachability and reservation. Own valid bed is preferred; explicit claim displacement is not autonomous permission to steal any bed.
LayDown reserves bed up to sleeping-slot capacity, or one ground cell. It claims nonmedical bed and walks to actual head slot; bed-use changes can fail/replan the toil.
DoorBase declares Building_Door,fill1,holdsRoof,blockLight and nonrotatable; Door declares25stuff and850base work. These are2D declarations, not a voxel height.

Generic stuff stats multiply factors then add offsets. Wood DoorOpenSpeed1.2 and WorkToBuild.7; StoneBlocksBase DoorOpenSpeed.45,BedRestEffectiveness.9,WorkToBuild6 with+140offset. Missing Steel door factor leaves baseline1 in the selected declarations.

Open duration is RoundToInt(45/DoorOpenSpeed*openFactor), with powered factor.25; close base110ticks, approaching pawn delay300, friendly-touch window120. Building factors default1, thermal intervals closed375/open34.
Open bool differs from fully opened; FreePassage=open&&(holdOpen||!WillCloseSoon). Pawn/item/corpse blockers prevent closing. Opening ticks, closing delay and heat transfer update separately.
Door passage considers pawn capability/faction. Path follower can request manual opening and wait TicksTillFullyOpened, then initiate closing after departure.
Any door cell is Portal independently of open state. Portal is a single-cell district excluded from ordinary room merging; opening does not merge neighboring room identities.
Original2D room UsesOutdoorTemperature if touching map edge or unroofed cells>=ceil(area*.25). This is separate from psychological outdoors and is not a3D flood-fill specification.
At nearly zero rest, ticks accumulate in150 increments. After1000ticks, involuntary sleep MTB starts.25day and declines at15000/30000/45000ticks; permission checks still apply.
